display.purpose: Hero headline, chapter names and the contact close.

tagline.purpose: The line under a project name, in secondary ink.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll entrance, once per element; opacity only under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 980px; background: #0071e3; color: #fff; font: 17px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.022em; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ed; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.html: Read the code
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #0066cc; font: 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Nav
components.description: Translucent bar the page scrolls under.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(251 251 253 / 0.86); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #6e6e73; } .ds-nav strong { color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 15px; margin-inline-end: auto; }

narrative.northStar: The engineer as a product page
narrative.overview: An Apple product page applied to a person: one idea per screen, real products as the hero material, quiet chrome, and one clear way to get in touch.
keyCharacteristics: Platform face with tight display tracking

rules.name: One blue
rules.body: Blue means act or go, nothing else.

rules.name: Name leads
rules.body: A chapter leads with the product name at display scale; no label above it.

dos: Show the product before describing it.
Keep one primary button per screen.
donts: No cards or pills as structure.
